summary: A single fetch loop with naive retries; one swallowed exception around the cache write.

findings.title: Cache write failures are swallowed
findings.description: fetch_orders wraps the cache write in a bare except that passes, so a full disk or a missing cache directory is invisible.
findings.recommendation: Log the exception at warning level and surface a metric; keep returning the fetched orders.

findings.title: Retries sleep a fixed time on 429
findings.description: A 429 answer is retried after two seconds regardless of the Retry-After header.
findings.recommendation: Honour Retry-After and back off exponentially.

findings.title: One upstream, no circuit breaker
findings.description: Every order comes from one API; there is no fallback when it is down.
